title: Thoracoabdominal Artery Stent Graft System Exploratory Study
official: Exploratory Study of Thoracoabdominal Artery Stent Graft System in the Treatment of Thoracoabdominal Aortic Aneurysms
summary: This study is designed as a single-center, prospective, single-arm, open-label, exploratory study. The objective is to evaluate the feasibility of Thoracoabdominal Artery Stent Graft System for endovascular treatment of Thoracoabdominal aortic aneurysms (TAAA).

interventions.name: The system includes the G-Branch™ thoracoabdominal aortic stent graft system, the peripheral vascular stent graft system, and the aortic extension stent graft system
